name: Tape Story
summary: A company timeline on a tape measure: pull the tape and each year's story flips up on a flag
about: An our-story timeline drawn as a yellow tape measure on a workbench. Drag along the bench and the tape runs out of its case on a spring, the spool turns, the hook leans as it moves, and a red rivet lights with a click at each year it passes. The milestone for the year at the hook flips up on a flag card that follows the tape, the last year bursts into sparks, and Rewind whips the tape back into the case with a thunk.
how: Drag along the tape (or click anywhere on it) to pull it out; it settles on the nearest year when you let go.
Watch the spool turn, the hook lean and the rivets light; the card above flips to the year at the hook.
Or use the year buttons, or focus the tape and press the arrow keys, Home or End to step year by year.
Press Rewind to send the tape back into its case.
